headline: GFG RESOURCES DRILLS DISTRICT-SCALE GOLD AT NAHANNI — 11.20 g/t AU IN FIRST-PASS TIMMINS CAMPAIGN
snippet: GFG Resources (TSXV: GFG) reported assay results May 28 from a 10-hole, 3,000-metre first-pass drill program at the Nahanni target on its Goldarm Property in the Timmins Gold District of Ontario. All three target areas returned gold mineralization including high-grade intervals above 5 g/t and locally above 10 g/t Au within a 6-kilometre corridor of the Pipestone Deformation Zone — a step-out far beyond previous drilling that validates the district-scale model.

headline: ERIC SPROTT DROPS $25M ON CANADA'S FIRST SUBSURFACE NATURAL HYDROGEN SYSTEM — MAXX CLOSES LAWSON DEAL
snippet: Max Power Mining (CSE: MAXX) closed a $25-million strategic private placement led by Eric Sprott on May 29 to advance the Lawson Complex near Central Butte, Saskatchewan — confirmed as Canada's first subsurface natural hydrogen system after validation by three independent labs. Proceeds fund follow-up drilling, seismic acquisition, and resource estimation. The backing of a legendary resource-sector financier signals institutional credibility for natural hydrogen as an emerging critical mineral play.

headline: GLENCORE-BACKED GROUP ELEVEN TRIPLES PG WEST DRILL PROGRAM TO 75,000M AS ZINC-LEAD-SILVER GROWS IN IRELAND
snippet: Group Eleven Resources (TSXV: ZNG), backed by Glencore and Barry Gentile, has tripled the size of its PG West zinc-lead-silver drill program from 20,000m to up to 75,000m after new holes at Ballywire returned 62.5m of 2.9% zinc, 2.7% lead, and 25 g/t silver — including 11.8m of 3.3% zinc and 10.1% lead. Ballywire is being called the most significant zinc discovery in Ireland in a decade. Zinc is not copper, but both sit in the copper-base-metals growth camp as electrification accelerates.

headline: CAMECO RESUMES FULL OUTPUT AT MCARTHUR RIVER AND KEY LAKE — FLOOD DISRUPTION CLEARED, 2026 URANIUM GUIDANCE HOLDS
snippet: Cameco (TSX/NYSE: CCJ) announced May 27 that both Key Lake and McArthur River have returned to full production activity after early-May flooding in northern Saskatchewan collapsed the primary road bridge into the sites. The 2026 uranium production outlook of 19.5–21.5 million pounds U3O8 remains unchanged. The episode is a reminder that even the world's largest uranium producer faces real operational vulnerability from northern Canadian infrastructure.

headline: NSW URANIUM BAN CLEARS UPPER HOUSE — AUSTRALIA'S MOST POPULOUS STATE A STEP CLOSER TO LIFTING 40-YEAR PROHIBITION
snippet: The NSW Legislative Council passed the Uranium Mining and Nuclear Facilities (Prohibitions) Repeal Bill, sending it to the Lower House where a final vote could lift Australia's most populous state's ban, in place since 1986. Passage would unlock exploration in a state with known uranium geology, add credibility to Australia's role as a Western uranium supplier, and give ASX-listed explorers a new regulatory tailwind.

headline: SILVER/GOLD RATIO FLASHES BULLISH SIGNAL — AND GOLDSEEK SAYS IT MAY BE PARTY TIME FOR PRECIOUS METALS
snippet: A GoldSeek analytical piece argues the silver-to-gold ratio is signalling a bullish phase for precious metals, noting that silver tends to dramatically outperform gold once the ratio moves into a defined zone. With spot silver having gained over $80/oz from the September 2025 lows alongside gold's $2,168 rise in the same period, the ratio dynamic could be pointing toward silver's next leg higher — a key thesis for investors rotating from gold into leveraged silver exposure.

headline: HUAYOU COBALT BIDS $210M FOR ATLANTIC LITHIUM'S GHANA EWOYAA PROJECT — CHINA EXTENDS AFRICAN MINERALS REACH
snippet: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt signed a binding acquisition deed in May to buy Atlantic Lithium for US$210 million, securing the Ewoyaa project in Ghana — Ghana's first lithium mine, JORC-compliant at 1.13 million tonnes LCE. The deal deepens China's African critical minerals footprint and raises questions about Western supply chain sovereignty just as lithium carbonate recovers approximately 49% year-to-date. ASX:A11 shareholders vote in November.

headline: CHINA'S LEPIDOLITE MINE CURTAILMENTS SEEN TIGHTENING LITHIUM SUPPLY — PRICE FLOOR BUILDING BELOW $25,000/T
snippet: Expected suspensions of Chinese lepidolite spodumene operations are expected to reduce supply and deepen the demand-supply imbalance already forming as energy storage consumption claims a bigger share of global lithium demand. Seeking Alpha's May 2026 lithium junior miners roundup tracks how these curtailments, alongside battery-grade carbonate's recovery to approximately $25,000/t, may be signalling a durable floor beneath the 2023–2025 bear market price cycle.

headline: K92 MINING REITERATES 2026 GUIDANCE — PAPUA NEW GUINEA GOLD PLAY HOLDS 50-DAY MOVING AVERAGE IN BULL MARKET
snippet: K92 Mining (TSX: KNT), operator of the high-grade Kainantu gold-copper-silver mine in Papua New Guinea, reaffirmed its 2026 production guidance in GoldSeek's SWOT analysis. With gold above $4,500/oz, K92's low-cost underground operations and expanding resource base put it in the class of junior-to-mid-tier producers where free cash flow is now material but the market cap has not yet re-rated to match. The 50-day moving average hold is the technical signal to watch.

headline: PRECIOUS METALS FLOOR HOLDS AS HAWKISH FED HITS GOLD BELOW $4,550 — GEOPOLITICAL BID RETURNS ON IRAN NEWS
snippet: INN's weekly precious metals roundup for the week ending May 29 shows gold and silver briefly falling below key levels on hawkish U.S. interest rate signals and a stronger dollar before geopolitical support — via the U.S.-Iran ceasefire extension — lifted metals back. The episode illustrates a recurring pattern in 2026: speculative selling meets a geopolitical bid, keeping the floor intact even when positioning looks crowded.

headline: RICK RULE ON GOLD, SILVER AND URANIUM: WHAT PRICE LEVELS ACTUALLY TRIGGER HIS BUY STRATEGY NOW
snippet: Legendary resource investor Rick Rule lays out the specific price levels in gold, silver, oil, and uranium he would need to see before deploying capital in each. With gold above $4,500 and uranium above $85/lb, Rule's framework — built on decades of junior mining cycles — offers a useful reality check against the current euphoria in precious metals and the increasingly crowded uranium trade.

headline: RARE EARTH STOCKS MAY 2026: THE BEST WESTERN SUPPLY CHAIN PICKS AS CHINA CONTROLS TIGHTEN
snippet: With China showing no sign of easing rare earth export controls post-Trump-Xi summit and the U.S. Project Vault strategic reserve still being built, Zacks reviews the best-positioned Western rare earth stocks heading into mid-2026. MP Materials (NYSE: MP), USA Rare Earth (USAR), and Energy Fuels (UUUU) lead the domestic supply chain buildout, with MP Materials expected to begin magnet sales from its Independence facility in H2 2026.
